verdict.rationale: The evidence pack never mentions a native accounting integration with QuickBooks, Xero or any similar tool, and never mentions automatic journal-entry sync. What it does show is an API that can 'pull workforce and payroll data out to your systems', plus CSV exports and webhooks. Those are developer building blocks or user-side workarounds rather than the product's own journal-sync capability, so they earn no credit.

support.subject: As an ops user, I can sync payroll journal entries automatically to my accounting software like QuickBooks or Xero
